body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: bce5362ef433d0f136ee4821f3761beb183f0ecb -->
Needs changes before merge: add the required before and after screenshots.

The code uses the same hidden-stock check as the playback display. The note appears before the worker check. The new structural test checks that the note appears when the stock is hidden and goes away when the stock is shown or simulation stops. I read the full diff and found no code blocker.

Local results, with main trial-merged:

- PR head: `bce5362ef433d0f136ee4821f3761beb183f0ecb`.
- Main: `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`.
- Trial merge: `af79424b25d95af10da23ec6b964cd4e197511dc`. Its first parent is the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The UI build passed. UI lib: 1,658 passed, 8 ignored. The new test `a_hidden_stock_is_said_under_the_transport` passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 11 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -j 16 -- -D warnings`: passed.

Extra suites run:

- Quick UI integration suites: `boundary` (3), `boundary_picks` (7), `contour_dxf_sketch` (2), `sinker_setup` (2), `tap_hand` (3), `theme_example` (3), `theme_files` (17), `waterjet_tool` (1). All passed.
- Light tests: motion lib (7), `adaptive_troch_island` (1), `adaptive_troch_neck` (1), `adaptive_troch_parallel` (1), app `pocket_pass_start` (1). All passed.
- No fixture, importer, post, motion or catalog file changed. No extra STEP or catalog suite was required. No GPU error occurred.

Mutations: not run. This change adds display text only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision and gouge checks. No golden file moved. No full heavy lane was required.

Requested before merge:

1. **UI evidence** — `crates/ui/src/play_precalc.rs:84`: the PR changes the visible transport, but the body says "No screenshot". Add before and after screenshots to the PR body for Simulate with the Stock row hidden. The after image must show the new note in the transport. Apply the screenshot check to each visible UI change. Put the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not commit them to this PR branch. This closes the missing-evidence class; the structural test does not replace the required images.

The PR merges cleanly with the tested main. The review state is `needs-rework` because of the missing images. Per the instructions for this run, I left all labels, the title, and the draft state unchanged. The warm review worktree remains in place.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
